signals.speaker: agent
signals.title: Compliance risk

patterns.re: \b(guarantee|guaranteed|one hundred percent|100 percent|definitely get|surely get|no risk at all|cannot be rejected)\b
patterns.nudge: Risky claim: approval cannot be guaranteed. Correct it now: the final decision is subject to credit assessment.

patterns.re: \b(tell you later|don't worry about the (fee|charges)|it is (very )?small)\b
patterns.nudge: Fee question deflected. State the processing fee (up to 2% plus GST) and point to the Key Fact Statement.

recording_disclosure.nudge: Recording disclosure missing. Tell the customer the call is recorded before continuing.

pricing_before_disclosure.pricing_re: \b(interest rate|rate of interest|processing fee|emi (of|will be)|percent interest)\b
pricing_before_disclosure.nudge: Rate quoted without the credit-assessment disclosure. Add: final terms are subject to credit assessment.

signals.resolve_agent: subject to (credit )?(assessment|approval|verification)|cannot guarantee|not guaranteed|this call is recorded|processing fee is

patterns.re: \b(lost (my|his|her) job|laid off|cannot pay|can't pay|unable to pay|no money|salary (is )?(delayed|late)|medical emergency|struggling to pay|tight this month)\b
patterns.nudge: Payment difficulty disclosed. Offer the approved payment-support / restructuring callback; do not push for payment now.

signals.speaker: customer
signals.title: Rising frustration
signals.nudge: Customer frustration is rising. Pause the script, acknowledge the concern, and summarize what you will do next.
signals.resolve_agent: i understand (your|how)|sorry for|i apologi[sz]e|i hear you|let me (help|fix)

signals.speaker: customer
signals.title: Missed cross-sell

patterns.nudge: Customer mentioned another vehicle. Offer the multi-vehicle discount on a second policy.
A new driver will use the car. Suggest adding a named driver so claims stay covered.
Customer plans to expand. Mention the expansion use of the Business Growth Loan.

signals.resolve_agent: multi[- ]?(vehicle|car)|second (car|vehicle|policy)|named driver|add (him|her|your son|your daughter|your wife)|another policy|expansion

signals.speaker: customer
signals.title: Callback needed

patterns.re: \b(call (me )?(back|later)|busy right now|in a meeting|i am driving|on the road|bad (line|signal|network)|signal is (weak|bad))\b
patterns.nudge: Customer can't talk properly now. Offer to schedule a callback at a better time.

signals.resolve_agent: call you back|schedule a callback|better time

signals.speaker: customer
signals.title: Buying signal

patterns.re: \b(how do i (apply|sign up|pay)|what is the next step|send me the (details|link)|sounds good|i want(ed)? to (renew|apply|buy)|can i pay online)\b
patterns.nudge: Buying signal. Confirm the next step and close: payment link or application.

signals.resolve_agent: payment link|send you the link|next step
